_comment: Synthetic incident store standing in for a real incident-tracker API (TheHive / ServiceNow SIR). Each record has stable IOCs so the agent can pivot on IP / hash / domain / user.

incidents.title: SSH brute force from Tor exit node
incidents.summary: 47 failed SSH auths in 3 minutes against bastion-01 from a known Tor exit node. Source IP blocked at the edge; no successful auth.

incidents.title: Repeated auth failures from Tor exit range
incidents.summary: Password guessing against the service account svc_backup. Account lockout policy triggered; no compromise.

incidents.title: Web app SQL injection attempts
incidents.summary: sqlmap fingerprints in access logs targeting the /api/search endpoint. WAF blocked union-based payloads. Investigating whether error-based payloads returned data.

incidents.title: Suspicious PowerShell + outbound beacon
incidents.summary: Endpoint j.doe-lt executed an encoded PowerShell payload followed by periodic HTTPS beacons to 91.240.118.172. Host isolated pending forensics.

incidents.title: Phishing campaign — invoice lure
incidents.summary: Two users received an invoice-themed phishing email linking to a credential-harvesting page. One clicked; credentials rotated proactively. Domain sinkholed.

incidents.title: Port scan sweep across DMZ
incidents.summary: Sequential TCP SYN sweep across DMZ hosts from the 45.155.205.0/24 range. Same range later associated with SQLi attempts (INC-2050).
